newsitem.title: UK: UK Estates urges rejecting Ashquay.
newsitem.headline: UK Estates urges rejecting Ashquay.

text.p: British property development firm UK Estates Plc on Friday urged its shareholders again to reject a takeover offer from Ashquay Group Plc.

Ashquay, which said on Friday it owns or has acceptances for 37.8 percent of UK Estates' issued ordinary share capital, is offering 10 shares for every 13 ordinary UK Estates shares. It said it was extending the offer to January 9.
UK Estates on Friday said it continued to recommend rejecting the offer.

"Ashquay's paper promises are no fair exchange for the investment made by the shareholders of UK Estates and the advice from the Board of UK Estates reamins to reject Ashquay's offers," UK Estates said in a statement.
